component.name: Vigil Task Manager
component.summary: Fast, free and open source task manager

description.p: Vigil is a task manager in the spirit of the Windows Task Manager, built for Linux first and also available for Windows. It is completely free: no subscriptions, no paid tiers, no telemetry and no accounts.

ul.li: Processes grouped into apps, background and system processes with heat-map columns
Performance graphs for CPU (overall and per core), memory, disks, network and GPUs
App history, startup apps, users, details and services pages
End task, end process tree, suspend/resume, priority, CPU affinity and efficiency mode
Works on X11 and Wayland with every desktop environment

description.p: Temperatures and sensors everywhere, a redesigned and clearer interface, and lower resource usage.

ul.li: Temperatures for CPU (per core), memory, disks, network adapters and GPUs; a new Sensors view with fans, voltages and power
Battery view with charge, power draw, health and cycles
Clearer process list: filter chips, collapsible groups, overview tiles and a detail pane with live graphs
Tree view on the Details page, tabbed process properties (threads, open files, environment), CSV export
Fewer full process scans while the process list is not visible
